description: FREE. Nationwide interstate and long-distance household moves between any two US states, plus local moves in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area. Licensed carrier USDOT 3764697, MC 1341637. Same indicative price per tariff as get_quote, no payment. Any two US ZIP codes. Optional contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email let Next Generation Movers call the customer to book. Returns booking link and phone (240) 422-2243.
